description: Asks one AI assistant (automation_id) a customer’s question and returns what it would do: its reply, the intent and confidence it read, the knowledge sources it used, whether it would hand the chat to a person, and the message a customer would receive. Nothing is sent to anyone. Each chat is one AI conversation on the plan, counted when the assistant is first asked in it; send the chat_id an answer returns, with history, to continue the same chat. For an assistant that is switched off, connection_id with holding_message (and escalate_keywords or closed hours) tries it with the set-up’s answers. Owners and admins.

automation_id.description: The AI assistant being tried: an automation of this workspace with one AI step. The answer comes from its own persona and knowledge, and from no other assistant’s. Alone, the try also uses the escalate_keywords of the version its conversations run (the switched-on one, else the newest), the first message of its branch for the cant_answer outcome of that step and its cause, and its closed message and opening hours; with connection_id, the set-up’s answers replace those.

chat_id.description: The Try it chat this message continues: the chat_id an earlier answer in it gave. Each chat counts as one AI conversation, billed like a real one, from the first time the assistant is asked in it. Null or left out starts a new chat; a history that already holds an assistant turn needs it, unless a turn in it was handed over.

closed.description: With connection_id: the set-up's closed message, opening hours (HH:MM, in the workspace's timezone) and closed-hours passing message. While closed, the answer's closed_message is the message with the hours, and a customer_message for a chat passed on is the closed-hours one.

holding_message.description: The set-up's message for when the assistant passes the chat on while closed, in place of holding_message: where it says {opens}, the customer reads when the business next opens. The AI receptionist's default when left out.

connection_id.description: For a receptionist that is not switched on: the number it is being set up on. Requires holding_message; escalate_keywords and closed as the set-up has them. They replace the settings of automation_id’s version.

escalate_keywords.description: With connection_id: the words that pass a chat to a person.

handed_over.description: True on the customer turn after which a person had the chat: its answer was cant_answer, and the automation's steps for that case hand the chat to a person. From then on, as in a real chat, the answer is outcome person_has_chat and the model is not asked.

holding_message.description: Required with connection_id, and only with it: the message a customer is sent when the assistant cannot answer.

name: try_assistant
title: Try the AI assistant
